labels.epicDescription: Epic: a large task with subtasks

comments.closedByPr: Closed by PR {prs}: GitHub didn't link the PR to the task

actualize.lead: {task} #{number} ({epicWord} #{epic}): epic refresh after the merge — bring the epic's open tasks in line with what shipped.
actualize.checks: Five checks (canon — reference.md of the github skill, «Epic refresh on task close»):
actualize.scope: You change only GitHub tasks — description, «{questions}», links, status; the github skill script — `{script}`: not done — `task drop <N>`, a new one — `task new … --branch-type <type> --epic {epic}` (it sets the estimate itself). Don't touch code, branches or git; don't close #{number}, epic #{epic} or their milestones — task close does that after you.
actualize.comment: What you fixed — one line in a comment on epic #{epic} (`gh issue comment {epic} --repo {repo}`); nothing to fix — no comment.
actualize.answer: Answer — fixes one per line with task numbers and questions to the owner, if any; otherwise «The block is current».
